summary: Buffer read-tracking advance: loads the buffer tracking struct pointer stored at a1+0x14, increments its first dword (current read position) by a2, decrements its second dword (remaining byte count) by a2, and returns the tracking pointer. No guards, no calls; pure stateful pointer arithmetic on the caller-supplied tracking struct.

operations.description: Load result = *(a1 + 0x14), the pointer to the buffer tracking struct.
Advance the current read position: result[0] += a2.
Decrease the remaining byte count: result[1] -= a2.
Return result, the buffer tracking pointer.

unresolved: a1's owner object and the exact layout of the buffer tracking struct at *(a1+0x14) are not established by the packet; the two dwords are conventionally a current position and a remaining count.
Units of a2 (bytes vs elements) and any bounds validation are caller responsibilities; this function performs no checks.
